title: 12 Best Jazz Bars in Chengdu
description: Discover Chengdu's top jazz bars for live music, crafted cocktails, and a vibrant atmosphere. From iconic clubs to upscale hotel lounges, find your perfect jazz night out.

places.name: Jellyfish Jazz Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature Jellyfish Martini or a classic Old Fashioned. Grab some nachos to share.

places.name: The Range (at The Temple House)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their expertly crafted gin-based cocktails or a fine whiskey from their extensive collection.

places.name: Muse Jazz Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of their house red wine or a classic Martini. Their cheese platter pairs well with the music.

places.name: NOLA Jazz Club & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Jambalaya or Gumbo, paired with a local craft beer or a classic Hurricane cocktail.

places.name: The Loft Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A local craft beer on tap or one of their house cocktails. Their burgers are surprisingly good for a bar.

places.name: Jing Bar (at The St. Regis Chengdu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their signature St. Regis Bloody Mary variations or a classic Champagne cocktail.

places.name: The Beer Nest III (Kuan Alley Store)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their extensive selection of local and imported craft beers. Their fries are a great snack.

places.name: The Chapter Bar (at Grand Hyatt Chengdu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bespoke cocktail crafted by their mixologists or a glass from their curated wine list.

places.name: The Bridge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Western-style appetizers and a craft beer. Ask about the nightly drink specials.

places.name: Steam Cafe & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A specialty coffee if you're there early, or a local craft beer later in the evening. Their desserts are also quite good.

places.name: The Volume Jazz Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic whiskey sour or a single malt Scotch from their impressive collection.

places.name: Moonlight Jazz Club
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their uniquely named signature cocktails or a glass of sparkling wine.
